assessment: Unused aggregate capacity does not establish usable capacity. Missing time windows, equipment requirements, and attendance dependencies prevent distinguishing allocation problems from genuine scarcity. Neither opening yet demonstrates the eight-week targets.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: reserve a suitable rehearsal capability at a fixed time, with the room assigned before arrival, so piano-independent groups can voluntarily exchange rooms without moving their rehearsal times.
openings.delta: Separate the time commitment from room identity; blank equipment fields must be resolved rather than treated as no requirement.
openings.prediction: Some declined piano-dependent requests become feasible through same-time room reassignment, with no loss of another group's acceptable rehearsal time.
openings.probe: Ask contacts for necessary equipment and acceptable windows. Replay the nine refusals against both rooms, allowing only consented room exchanges. Count newly feasible requests and minutes spent. Pilot only confirmed exchanges, issuing matching paper and online records plus telephone or in-person confirmation; preserve each requested weekly 60-minute entitlement and both performances.
assumptions: Both groups' confirmed equipment requirements remain satisfied.
Confirmation can fit the two-hour weekly administration target.

openings.claim: Some apparently independent group reservations may compete for the same essential musicians, making overlapping bookings unusable even when rooms are available.
openings.delta: Treat shared-person availability as a possible scheduling constraint alongside rooms and group contacts.
openings.prediction: Late or missed sessions disproportionately coincide with another commitment involving an essential shared member; absent this pattern, the hypothesis weakens.
openings.probe: During short contact conversations, ask whether each late or missed session involved such a clash and which time windows avoid recurrence; compare with attended sessions. Test whether a paper schedule avoiding confirmed clashes still meets stated needs and every requested weekly entitlement within existing hours, equipment, and protected performances. Record interview and rescheduling time.
assumptions: Groups may share essential members; this is unobserved.
Reported correlations would support further testing, not establish causation.
